exercises.title: Risk 1 — assessment or control?
exercises.problemHtml:
Risk management (Figure 32-1): risk assessment = identification, analysis (probability, impact), prioritisation; risk control = management planning (mitigation, contingency, owner, timeline), resolution (executing the plans), monitoring (tracking progress). Classify.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Đánh giá rủi ro (nhận diện, phân tích, xếp ưu tiên) vs kiểm soát rủi ro (lập kế hoạch, giải quyết, giám sát).

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Risk 2 — risk exposure and the top risks
exercises.problemHtml:
Risk exposure = probability (0–1) × impact (1–10). Write function topRisks(risks, n) returning the ids of the n risks with the highest exposure (ties by id), and function worthMitigating(costOfMitigation, risk, costPerImpactPoint) returning true only if the mitigation costs less than the expected loss (exposure × costPerImpactPoint) — "it makes no sense to spend $20,000 controlling a risk whose maximum impact is $10,000". Ignore risks whose probability is outside 0–1 or impact outside 1–10.

Requirements

  • topRisks(RISKS, 2) ⇒ ["RK-3", "RK-1"].
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mức phơi nhiễm = xác suất × tác động. Viết topRisks(risks, n) và worthMitigating(...): chỉ đáng giảm thiểu khi chi phí nhỏ hơn tổn thất kỳ vọng.

Yêu cầu

  • topRisks(RISKS, 2) ⇒ ["RK-3", "RK-1"].
hintsJson: Chỉ giảm thiểu khi chi phí < tổn thất kỳ vọng.

exercises.title: Risk 3 — writing a risk statement
exercises.problemHtml:
Write risks in a condition–consequence format: the risk condition, then the possible adverse outcome — "If the customers don’t agree on the product requirements, then we might satisfy only one of them." Record probability, impact, exposure, mitigation, owner and date (Figure 32-2). A risk list is not a risk management plan.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Risk 3 — writing a risk statement — answer key

1. Which is a well-formed risk statement?Phát biểu rủi ro nào đúng dạng?
   Answer: a) If the product owner leaves mid-project, then backlog decisions may stall for weeks.
   Condition → consequence.VI: Điều kiện → hậu quả.

2. A mitigation that reduces the probability of a risk is…Biện pháp giảm XÁC SUẤT của rủi ro là…
   Answer: a) naming a backup product owner and sharing knowledge regularly
   Mitigation can reduce probability or impact; contingency acts after.VI: Giảm thiểu giảm xác suất hoặc tác động; dự phòng dùng khi đã xảy ra.

exercises.title: Risk 4 — sources of project risk
exercises.problemHtml:
Projects face risks from many sources: dependence on external entities; project management (poor estimation, turnover, poor visibility); technology (complex, leading-edge work); lack of knowledge (inexperience with tools or the domain); and requirements. Classify each risk.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
